items.title: 一艘中国船只，因 AI 编造的情报，差点被美军登船拦截
items.title_zh: AI 编造情报，美军差点登船拦截中国船只
items.title_en: AI-Fabricated Intel Nearly Triggered US Boarding of Chinese Ship
items.summary: A CNN report claims a US military operation against a Chinese ship was nearly launched based on intelligence fabricated by an AI chatbot, highlighting severe risks of AI hallucination in military decision-making.

items.title: Samsung is expected to more than double output of its HBM4 and HBM4E DRAM
items.title_zh: 三星计划将HBM4与HBM4E DRAM产量提升一倍以上
items.title_en: Samsung to more than double HBM4 and HBM4E DRAM output
items.summary: Samsung is expected to more than double HBM4 and HBM4E DRAM output, a significant supply-chain development for AI memory and broader DRAM markets.

items.title: ChatGPT now knows what you do on other websites via ad collector
items.title_zh: ChatGPT 被指通过广告技术收集器追踪站外活动
items.title_en: ChatGPT Reportedly Tracks Off-Site Activity via Adtech Collectors
items.summary: ChatGPT is now using adtech-style collectors to track users' activity on other websites, sparking privacy concerns and debate about expectations of privacy in AI chat products.

items.title: 大脑由两个不同的器官构成 原始部分负责生理功能 另一部分负责独特思考推理能力
items.title_zh: 斯坦福研究：大脑实为两个独立演化的器官构成
items.title_en: Stanford Study: The Brain Is Built From Two Independently Evolved Organs
items.summary: Stanford researchers report that the brain arises from two independently evolved, genetically distinct progenitor lineages rather than a single ancestor cell, overturning the prevailing model of brain development.
